requests.prompt: Realistic character reference sheet for a modern open world game (the look of Watch Dogs 2: grounded, real proportions, natural skin and cloth, no cartoon). Three full body views of the same person side by side on a plain light grey background: front, left side, back. Standing straight in a relaxed A-pose, arms slightly away from the body, feet flat, whole body visible from head to feet with space around it, even soft studio light, no text, no logos, photoreal game art. A memorable lead character with a distinct face you would recognise again, like a film lead, not a generic stock person. The person: an Indian man from Delhi, age 28, auto-rickshaw driver, young but sun-worn, lean wiry build, 1.72 m, realistic proportions about 7.5 heads tall. Face: warm brown skin tanned darker on the forehead and cheeks, a lively expressive face with a quick crooked grin and laugh lines starting at the eyes, slightly sleepy tired eyes that still look amused, thin neat moustache and two days of stubble, a small chipped front tooth, short black hair messy from wind with a few strands on the forehead. Clothes: loose faded khaki uniform shirt with sleeves rolled to the elbows, top button open, worn untucked, sweat marks at the collar, dark grey cotton trousers, worn rubber sandals, a red and white checked cotton gamchha towel over the left shoulder, an old plain steel wristwatch on the left wrist. He looks like the funniest man at the auto stand.

review.note: Approved 2026-11-14 as the look: 28, lean, a big crooked grin and laugh lines, wind-messy hair, sweat on the shirt, steel watch, gamchha; reads as the funniest man at the stand. For the 3D model, make one more sheet of the same man with a closed-mouth relaxed face (open grin baked into a 3D face fights the face animation), and without the reddish patches under the eyes.
review.fitNote: Sheet; for image to 3D use a neutral-face variant.
